scams.name: George Town Tourist-Hypnosis (Pukau) Robbery Ring
scams.description: On Persiaran Gurney around 8 PM, a well-dressed foreigner stops you with friendly questions: 'Are you Japanese? My wife is Japanese.' A handshake, a shoulder touch, a scented business card — and you 'wake up' 30 minutes later at an ATM with your wallet, jewelry, and PIN gone, no memory of the walk over. NST 'Iranians remanded over tourist hypnosis scam' (article 1254749, Aug 3 2025) is the canonical case — five Iranians remanded after three thefts in Gurney and Pulau Tikus. FMT covered a Nov 28 2025 raid on two Simpang Ampat bungalows that broke a parallel Japanese-victim syndicate. Step out of handshake range, refuse 'friendly' approaches firmly, and never accept an offered drink, cigarette, or scented card from a stranger. If you feel a sudden 'cloudy' sensation, walk into the nearest hotel lobby or 7-Eleven and sit until it passes.
scams.avoidance: Step back from handshake range of any 'friendly' stranger in Gurney, Pulau Tikus, Armenian St NEVER accept drink, cigarette, scented card from a stranger — pukau uses aerosols Do NOT walk with any stranger to an ATM, hotel, or vehicle — canonical pukau end-state If you feel 'cloudy' mid-conversation, immediately enter a hotel lobby or 7-Eleven Solo older travelers primary target — walk in pairs at dusk; call 999; Tourism Malaysia 1-300-88-5050
scams.location: Persiaran Gurney / Gurney Drive seafront promenade, Gurney Plaza entrances, Pulau Tikus shophouses, Jalan Penang hotel strip, Upper Penang Road bar district, Armenian Street / Love Lane café zone, George Town Eastern & Oriental / Cheong Fatt Tze heritage hotel forecourts
scams.tldr: Penang's most-press-documented 2025 violent-financial tourist crime is the pukau (hypnosis) distraction-robbery ring working George Town, Gurney Drive, Pulau Tikus and Jalan Penang.

scams.name: Penang International Airport (PEN) Grab Cancellation & Taxi-Tout Scam
scams.description: At PEN arrivals in Bayan Lepas, your Grab driver accepts your pickup, then cancels two minutes before arrival — repeats three times until you give up and walk to the taxi queue. There a 'prebet sapu' tout pitches RM100 to George Town; the real Grab fare is RM25–RM45, and the official prepaid coupon (desk inside arrivals) is RM44.70. A July 10 2025 law made unauthorized taxi touting at PEN explicitly illegal. Late-night (11 PM–5 AM) Grab coverage is thin and touts exploit the gap. Book Grab on airport Wi-Fi before walking out — meet at the signposted pickup zone level 1 outside arrivals. If a driver cancels, you cancel and rebook (no fee, no WhatsApp deals). Late nights, use the prepaid coupon desk — RM44.70 George Town, RM74.30 Batu Ferringhi — pay at the desk, not the driver.
scams.avoidance: Book Grab/InDrive BEFORE leaving arrivals — meet at signposted level 1 pickup zone If driver cancels, cancel your side too (no fee) and rebook — no WhatsApp, no off-app If no Grab (late-night), use OFFICIAL prepaid taxi coupon desk INSIDE arrivals — pay the desk NEVER accept 'taxi? taxi?' from anyone approaching inside arrivals — illegal since Jul 10 2025 Rapid Penang 401E to KOMTAR is RM3.40 (45 min); Grab Advance Booking 24 hrs ahead
scams.location: Penang International Airport (PEN) Bayan Lepas arrivals hall, prepaid taxi coupon desk, Grab pickup zone level 1, PEN departure curb, airport-taxi queue outside arrivals, Rapid Penang 401E bus stop

scams.name: Gurney Drive & New Lane Hawker 'Tourist Price' Overcharge
scams.description: At a Gurney Drive Hawker Centre seafood stall, a 'market price' grilled stingray lands you a RM150 bill — the local rate is RM30. Char koay teow at tourist stalls runs RM18–RM25; the real Penang rate is RM8–RM12 at any kopitiam. Fresh sugarcane juice marked at RM18 vs RM4–RM6 a block over. Local consensus is blunt: 'AVOID GURNEY DRIVE HAWKER, it's a total tourist trap.' Go to Chulia Street night stalls, Kimberley Street, Lorong Selamat, or Sri Weld food court instead. Always ask 'berapa?' before ordering. Local benchmark prices: char koay teow RM8–RM12, hokkien mee RM8–RM12, laksa RM7–RM10, nasi kandar RM10–RM18, fresh juice RM4–RM6. If overcharged, pay only what you agreed and report to MBPP municipal council 04-263-7637.
scams.avoidance: AVOID Gurney Drive Hawker Centre first time — go Chulia St, Kimberley St, Lorong Selamat ALWAYS ask 'berapa?' BEFORE ordering — refusal to quote is the red flag NEVER order 'seafood market price' without a written per-kg quote on paper Benchmark: char koay teow RM8–RM12, laksa RM7–RM10, fresh juice RM4–RM6 Pay with exact change; file complaint with MBPP 04-263-7637 if overcharged
scams.location: Gurney Drive Hawker Centre / Gurney Bay relocation site, Persiaran Gurney seafront, New Lane (Lorong Baru) Macalister Road night stalls, Lorong Selamat, Chulia Street backpacker strip, Komtar food-court ring, Love Lane café zone
scams.tldr: Penang's famed hawker culture has a documented 'tourist price' overlay at specific centers.

scams.name: George Town Street-Art & Costumed-Character Photo Shakedown
scams.description: At Ernest Zacharevic's 'Little Children on a Bicycle' on Armenian Street, a 'friendly local' with a phone steps in: 'I take your photo with mural, my angle better!' Hands you the picture — then demands RM200 'photo service fee.' Or a Spider-Man on Upper Penang Road poses in your shot then asks RM50 per family member. Or a 'sifu' near Kuan Yin Temple offers a 'free' palm reading and demands RM300. All Zacharevic murals in George Town are FREE public art — nobody has authority to charge a 'photo permission' fee. If a stranger offers to take your photo, say 'no thanks, my friend will' and hand the phone only to fellow travelers. Don't pose with costumed characters. 'Free' caricature, 'free' photo, 'free' palm-reading = always a shakedown. If pressured, walk to Mugshot Coffee or ChinaHouse and ask them to call PDRM 999.
scams.avoidance: ALL Ernest Zacharevic murals are FREE public art — no 'photo fee' is legitimate If a stranger offers to take your photo: 'no thanks' — phone only to fellow travelers 'Free' caricature, photo, palm-reading, bar-guide = always a shakedown — refuse at 'free' Offer RM5–RM10 max if pressured after unrequested service, walk firmly Solo tourists are primary target — phone in bag between shots; PDRM 999 if threatened
scams.location: Armenian Street 'Little Children on a Bicycle' mural, Cannon Street 'Boy on Chair' mural, Lebuh Ah Quee, Lebuh Muntri, Love Lane café strip, Upper Penang Road bar district, Kuan Yin Temple forecourt, Clan Jetties (Chew / Lee / Tan Jetty) tourist entrances

scams.name: George Town Trishaw Tour Bait-and-Switch & Commission Stops
scams.description: A Penang trishaw rider at KOMTAR quotes 'RM40 for 1-hour heritage tour.' Fifteen minutes in, he diverts to a commission-paying batik shop, then a 'famous' herbal medicine store, then an 'ancestral temple' with donation pressure — each stop 10–20 minutes. Promised landmarks (Blue Mansion, Clan Jetties) 'skipped due to traffic.' At drop-off the price flips: 'RM40 per person, not total.' A viral 2025 video filmed a Chinese tourist tearing up cash in a heated argument with a Penang trishaw rider over exactly this. Fair 2025 rate: RM40–RM60 per HOUR per trishaw — confirm per-hour vs per-person in writing before boarding. Name specific landmarks ('Blue Mansion — Clan Jetties — Armenian Street — back to KOMTAR') and refuse all unrequested shop stops. The George Town heritage zone is 100% walkable in 2 hours.
scams.avoidance: Fair rate: RM40–RM60 per HOUR per trishaw (1–2 passengers) — not per person Confirm per-hour vs per-person IN WRITING; name specific landmarks; refuse shop stops Photograph license plate / driver ID before boarding; pay at END in cash exact change Cruise-day tours from Swettenham Pier: agree return with 45-min buffer before boarding Heritage zone is 100% walkable — use free Tourist Info map from Lebuh Pantai instead
scams.location: KOMTAR trishaw stand, Cheong Fatt Tze 'Blue Mansion' forecourt, Armenian Street murals, Clan Jetties entrance, Swettenham Pier cruise terminal, Penang Ferry Terminal (Butterworth), Chulia Street / Love Lane night hire, Upper Penang Road post-midnight

scams.name: George Town Tourist Minimart Unlabeled-Price Overcharge
scams.description: At an independent minimart on Chulia Street, you grab a 1.5 L bottle of mineral water and a pack of tissues. The cashier asks 'where from? first time Penang?' while scanning, the bill is RM18 — the same items at the 7-Eleven 100 meters away are RM3. Independent souvenir shops on Armenian Street ring up RM25 keychains that cost RM5 at Chowrasta Market; SIM-card booths quote RM80 for the RM35 Celcom/DiGi tourist SIM. Always shop at chain stores — 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, KK Mart, Watsons, Guardian — for water, snacks, pharmacy, SIM. Benchmark prices: 1.5 L water RM1.80–RM2.50, can of beer RM5–RM8, Panadol 10-pack RM4–RM6, tourist SIM RM30–RM40. Ask 'berapa?' before placing items on the counter at any independent shop — 'we calculate later' is the red flag. For souvenirs, use Chowrasta Market or Him Heang / Ghee Hiang.
scams.avoidance: Shop at CHAIN stores only — 7-Eleven, FamilyMart, KK Mart, Watsons, Guardian Benchmark: 1.5 L water RM1.80–RM2.50, beer RM5–RM8, DiGi SIM RM30–RM40 ALWAYS ask 'berapa?' per item BEFORE counter at independent shops — vague reply = red flag Souvenirs: Chowrasta Market, Him Heang, Ghee Hiang — 50–70% cheaper than Armenian St Pay by TouchNGo / DuitNow QR for auto-receipt; report to TTPM if overcharged
scams.location: Armenian Street independent shops, Chulia Street backpacker-strip minimarts, Love Lane / Lebuh Muntri convenience stores, Clan Jetties (Chew / Lee / Tan Jetty) entrance souvenir shops, Lebuh Ah Quee mural-adjacent kiosks, Little India souvenir stalls, Swettenham Pier cruise-terminal gift shops
